name: Mahila Bakri Palan
benefit: Under this scheme, one unit of goats (3 females and 1 male) aged 12 to 18 months is provided to eligible women. The entire cost of the scheme, ₹35,000, is borne by the State Government.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a woman. 1. The applicant must be from one of the following categories: - Abandoned - Widow - Destitute - Single woman - Disaster-affected woman
